paragraphs.0: (Demo) A script wrote this section; no helper really thought of it. We have several helpers here, and an article used to be written by one of them from start to end while the others waited.
paragraphs.1: Now a artifact is stored in blocks, each with its own version. Each helper writes its own section without fighting over a block, and the bar on the left shows at a glance who wrote which.
paragraphs.2: This demo lets you see it for yourself: three helpers write at once, the words grow paragraph by paragraph, and in the end they make one whole article.

paragraphs.0: (Demo) Each helper first inserts an empty paragraph at the end of its section, then replaces that paragraph about once a second, so it looks like a paragraph slowly growing.
paragraphs.1: Every change goes through the same op pipeline as yours: inserting is insert_block, growing is update_text with the last version's number, and the server takes them in order, batch by batch.
paragraphs.2: If you change the words in a paragraph a helper is writing, the helper's next write conflicts and does not go in; it leaves that paragraph to you and goes on to the next.

paragraphs.0: (Demo) Once broadcasting is done, the page will no longer ask the server every second: when a helper writes, you see it at once.
paragraphs.1: Later, a helper that wants to change another section's words will not change them directly but leave a suggestion for you to approve; a finished section is marked in the outline as done and waiting for you.
paragraphs.2: That is the end of the demo. Keep this artifact or delete it: it touches no ticket and no memory.
